findings.report: Hostile fuzz-seed coverage is established solely by a filename token; unique benign ASCII content satisfies the hostile class without any hostile property.
The commute generator selects the blank separator as its second line, so it never constructs the declared pair of independent block edits.
The transform oracle checks only outcome-class symmetry and added-token presence, allowing noncommuting forward and swapped merged outputs.
